title: Mio CLI flag -> engine/SDK semantic map and allowed-difference ledger
description: Machine-checkable DES-03 ledger. Every real CLI flag/alias from src/bin/mio_cli/args.rs (plus -h/--help/-V/--version/--) is assigned to exactly one entry. engine_mapping entries must point at a real Args field, a real wiring location, real public API declarations, and a real test definition. allowed_difference entries must use one of the bounded DES-03 reasons. Static checks only: this manifest never claims that a behavior test passed.

classificationRules.engine_mapping: The flag is wired to shared engine semantics through RunOptions/RunTools/ToolPolicy/Config/Host or a public engine module. Engine-mapping entries must not be excused as rendering.
classificationRules.allowed_difference: The flag only changes presentation, approval interaction form, persistence defaults, an explicit host-supplied connection/model value, or is a standalone maintenance command. Reason must be one of the bounded enum below.

allowedDifferenceReasons.terminal_rendering: CLI-only presentation of the shared event stream (text/json/rpc formatting, help text). Does not alter engine state, admission, budgets or recovery.
allowedDifferenceReasons.approval_interaction: CLI-only approval interaction form (TTY / non-TTY / RPC broker). The admission decision itself stays in the public ToolPolicy; the flag never changes which calls are admitted.
allowedDifferenceReasons.persistence_defaults: CLI-only persistence default: where/whether a session file is loaded or written. The engine receives the same history and Host API; no engine branch is introduced.
allowedDifferenceReasons.host_configuration: Explicit host-supplied connection/model value (model, provider preset, base URL). The engine routes the same Config regardless of who supplies it; no CLI-only execution branch.
allowedDifferenceReasons.maintenance: Standalone CLI maintenance/introspection command that does not enter the shared agent run loop. It is explained individually below and, where it touches engine-owned state, uses the listed public API.
